A package repository and its signing key: a .repo file for dnf, or a .sources file for apt, which then refreshes its package lists.

```hcl
step "example" {
  repository {
    key = "..."
    name = "..."
    url = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `components` | list of string | No | apt components. Defaults to ["main"]. |
| `key` | string | Yes | ASCII-armored public key the repository is signed with. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Repository name, used for its file names. |
| `on_remove` | string | No | "forget" (default) leaves the repository, "delete" removes its files. |
| `suites` | list of string | No | apt suites, such as ["noble"]. Required on Debian and Ubuntu. |
| `url` | string | Yes | Base URL. dnf expands $releasever and $basearch in it. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_repository.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the repository's files match. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_repository` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
